description: This file defines a public enum OpenClawBonjour containing constants and methods for managing Bonjour service types and domains, including normalization and environment-based resolution.

methods.name: resolveWideAreaDomain
methods.description: Resolves the wide area domain from environment variable, normalizing and comparing against the default gateway service domain.

methods.name: normalizeServiceDomain
methods.description: Normalizes a raw domain string by trimming, lowercasing, and ensuring proper suffix and default domain handling.
